newsitem.title: USA: Unicom Corp Q1 net off as costs increase.
newsitem.headline: Unicom Corp Q1 net off as costs increase.

text.p: Unicom Corp said Thursday its earnings in the first quarter ended March 31 fell in the wake of a double-digit jump in operating and maintenance expenses.

The utility holding company said net income reached $111 million, or $0.51 a share, versus $137 million, or $0.64, in the same period in 1996. Revenues increased to $1.75 billion from $1.68 billion a year ago.

Unicom said operating and maintenance expenses, which include costs for performance improvement efforts at Commonwealth Edison's nuclear power plants, rose 11 percent during the first quarter compared to 1996 figures.
Unicom shares closed up 1/8 Thursday at 19-1/8.
